propositions: caused_by edges lack a provenance marker to distinguish blame-derived from explicitly supplied attributions, making confidence in edge targets uncomputable
the file-level auto-derivation achieves 43% agreement with recorded edges, 7% disagreement, and 50% abstention on 88 closed bugs carrying caused_by edges
on 8 subsample bugs with independently proven origins, the deriver reproduced zero correct attributions and named an innocent target once when it did not abstain (1 wrong-target / 7 abstained)
unmet obligation, carrier commit, and omission defect shapes dominate root causes but are hard for file-blame and mostly land in deriver abstention, not misattribution
a derived-vs-explicit provenance marker is needed to let consumers weight or exclude guesses; shape-aware decline logic is unimplementable because defect shape is not observable to the mechanism
